_about: Short exchanges showing how Freya sounds in a given moment. A few are chosen per message and put in the system prompt as examples of tone (lib/voice-examples.ts), skipping any too close to what was just said, so she can't simply copy the answer. Never history, and never training data. Add your own freely; a new text in the same reply is a new array entry.
